backend/main.mo: Main backend canister handling authorization, user profiles, and publishing media assets (hero, images, videos, song) with storage mixins and access control.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module upgrading stored media arrays to fixed lengths and carrying forward versioning and user profile data.
feature_evidence.json: Report listing feature evidence entries linking features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing their roles in UI, media handling, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark theme variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up root element and loading the main frontend script.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Documentation explaining how to update media via in-app uploads or file replacement with fallback behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component orchestrating unlock flow, intro popup, media sections, popups, and MediaStore provider.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: Interactive flip card showing an image on the front and a message on the back, with optional zoom/pan transforms.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Renders multiple animated floating heart elements positioned randomly on screen.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with optional media manager button, dynamic background, and decorative birthday text.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Modal for zooming, panning, and resetting image transforms before saving adjustments.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Displays a grid of FlipImageCard components populated from media store and memory config data.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: A simple animated intro popup prompting the user to enter the site with a themed button.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Password entry screen that validates input, shows errors, and triggers unlock when correct.
Popup displaying a long love letter with typing animation and a close button.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Comprehensive media management dialog supporting uploads, ordering, transforms, previews, and publishing workflows.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Audio player that autoplays a selected or default song with play/pause controls and mute handling.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Popup modal showing a romantic promise message with animations and a close button.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Renders animated falling rose petals using randomly positioned emoji elements.
Section with two buttons that trigger opening a love letter or proposal popup.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Displays a grid of videos with mute toggling and fallback handling, using stored or default video URLs.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Generates 43 image memory items with placeholder paths and rotating romantic messages.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: List of customizable romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines six video memory items with placeholder video file paths.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context managing loading, storing, uploading, and clearing of hero, image, video, and song media with blob URL cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking. Uses Dfinity AuthClient with custom options and exposes a hook to access auth state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages a media draft state including hero, images, videos, song, ordering, transforms, and drag operations. Supplies setters and utility functions for updating and reordering media slots.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Simple wrapper hook that returns the media store context. Provides access to shared media store functions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish checks, backend publishing, and persisting changes with diagnostic reporting. Tracks publish status and exposes runPrecheck, publish, and reset methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Implements a simple password gate stored in sessionStorage to lock or unlock access. Exposes unlock status and a function to attempt unlocking.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Creates a typing animation effect for text, revealing characters over time. Returns the displayed text and whether the animation is complete.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers, color variables, and custom animations for a romantic theme. Includes styles for floating hearts, flip cards, and motion effects.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Utility for normalizing errors into diagnostic payloads with optional details and cause information. Provides helpers for safe stringification and formatting diagnostics for console or user display.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: Implements an IndexedDB-backed store for saving, retrieving, listing, and clearing media blobs by slot type and index.
frontend/src/lib/publishedMediaClient.ts: Provides functions to upload media changes to the backend with progress callbacks and fetch published media as URLs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Describes overall project state, architecture, features, and known issues for the ICP canister-based romantic app.
